beats.note: It is also important to distinguish encryption from hashing.
Hashing transforms data into a fixed-length value, called a hash, but it is not designed to be reversed.
Hashing is commonly used to store passwords securely and to verify whether data has been changed.
Digital signatures are related to public-key cryptography as well, but they serve a different purpose.
Encryption is mainly used to protect confidentiality,
while digital signatures help verify the identity of the sender and confirm that the message has not been modified.
